query: What disclaimers are required for up to percent off pricing?

naive_results.chunk_text:
Pricing Language

All pricing claims must follow the standard format below. This format was negotiated with Legal in 2024 and is required for compliance with state consumer protection laws.

* For range claims, write "Up to 40 percent off" never "40% off" alone.
* For tiered claims, always include t

Pricing Claims

### Up To Claims

Any "up to X percent off" claim must include the minimum discount available in the offer. Example: "Up to 40 percent off, starting at 10 percent off."

This is required by Federal Trade Commission guidance on representative pricing claims.
